description: This workbook reports ecotoxicity and genetic-toxicity results for anaerobically treated kraft-pulp bleaching effluent subjected to ozone or ozone/UV post-treatment. The research collaborators publish negative and positive controls, mutagenicity, aberration and a further response index labelled inconsistently in repository text. The Data in Brief article places the study in São Paulo, Brazil, and links it with a separate deposit for the preceding anaerobic-treatment experiment. Coverage is a laboratory treatment comparison; a common calendar period is not established. Mendeley distributes the Excel file free under CC BY 4.0. Assay-specific endpoints, laboratory doses and unclear terminology are limitations for translating responses into plant-scale environmental impacts. Modellers could compare biological effect indicators alongside conventional removal predictions in wastewater simulations. model-dhi-west-wastewater-treatment-process-modelling is a related environment. Only documentation and metadata were inspected; no assay values were downloaded or interpreted as regulatory safety thresholds.
